headings:
For outdoor lovers, the poolside rooftop party area on the 8th floor offers a mesmerizing open-sky view, perfect for evening celebrations. Additional amenities include a fitness gym, business center, elevator, travel desk, laundry service, and ample private parking.
Grand Tamanna's versatility and service excellence place it among the top hotels in Hinjawadi Pune. Whether you're planning a business trip, a weekend escape, or a large-scale event, the hotel ensures an unmatched experience in luxury, service, and hospitality.

paragraphs: Hotels Restaurants Wedding and Party venue Offers Daily Baker more about us contact us Gallery Blogs Book Now Book Now Menu Hotels Restaurants Wedding and Party venue Offers Daily Baker more about us contact us Gallery Blogs Grand Tamanna Hotel Grand Tamanna stands as a flagship property of Tamanna Hotels and is one of the most sought-after hotels in Hinjawadi Pune. Perfectly located in the heart of the IT hub, Grand Tamanna blends premium hospitality with thoughtful amenities, making it an ideal choice for both corporate travelers and leisure guests.

Guests can enjoy fine dining at “Around The World”, a multi-cuisine restaurant with a capacity of up to 110 guests. For more intimate gatherings, the Nirvana Lounge is ideal a venue with ambient lighting and a well-stocked bar. The property also offers banquet spaces like Eternity, suitable for up to 300 guests, and a grand banquet hall accommodating up to 600 people for weddings, corporate events, and social functions.

The hotel features 46 spacious premium rooms and 1 luxurious suite, each designed with elegant interiors, a king-size bed, mini fridge, LED TV, and complimentary high-speed leased-line Wi-Fi. The suite room offers 450 sq. ft. of space with carpeted flooring, a bathtub, fruit basket, and complimentary breakfast, making it perfect for an indulgent stay.

The Premium Party Venue offers refined banquet facilities with the exclusive Nirvana Lounge Party Area, designed to host corporate events and gatherings of up to 100 guests. With a professional ambiance, tailored menus, and seamless service, it provides the perfect setting for business celebrations, networking events, and company parties. Guests can also enjoy a premium bar with outdoor seating, creating a relaxed yet sophisticated atmosphere for socializing.
